deviceCheck.title: Getting ready
deviceCheck.arReady: AR is ready on this phone.
deviceCheck.arUnavailable: AR is not available on this phone. You will train in 3D mode. The steps and scoring are the same.
deviceCheck.space: Clear about 2 × 2 metres of floor and make sure the area is well lit. Stay aware of real hazards around you.

reasons.insecure-context: This page is not opened securely, so AR is blocked.
reasons.no-webxr: This browser does not support AR. Use Chrome on Android.
reasons.no-immersive-ar: This phone does not support web AR (it needs Google Play Services for AR).
reasons.check-failed: The AR check failed on this phone.

errors.camera-denied: Camera access was denied. Allow the camera for this app in Chrome settings, then try again.
errors.not-supported: This phone could not start AR with floor tracking. Use 3D mode instead.
errors.unknown: AR could not start. Use 3D mode, or try again.

placement.searching: Move your phone slowly and point it at the floor
placement.ready: Tap the screen to place the training area

exit.title: Leave this training?
exit.body: This attempt will not be counted.

arStopped.title: AR stopped
arStopped.body: The camera view was closed. Continue in AR, or switch to 3D mode.
